capability.summary: Render one Markdown string to HTML with markdown-it defaults
capability.description: Instantiates MarkdownIt with its default preset and renders the supplied Markdown string to an HTML fragment returned under the html field.
capability.problem_space: One-shot Markdown-to-HTML conversion using markdown-it-py's uncustomized parser and renderer.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one Markdown string; output: wrapper JSON containing the rendered HTML string under html.
accepted_inputs: Markdown or plain text accepted by a default MarkdownIt instance
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.markdown_it_render", and html as the complete HTML fragment string rendered by a default MarkdownIt instance. A caught Markdown parsing or rendering exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.markdown_it_render", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: uses a fresh default MarkdownIt instance with no plugins, custom rules, presets, or renderer options supplied by the caller
does not sanitize the resulting HTML and must not be treated as an XSS-cleaning step
returns an HTML fragment in a JSON field rather than writing a standalone HTML document or file
does not expose parsed tokens, source maps, or rendering diagnostics

output_contract.description: HTML fragment rendered from the input Markdown and returned in the html field.

intent_tags: convert a Markdown string to an HTML fragment
negative_intents: sanitize untrusted HTML or Markdown output
extract a Markdown syntax tree or token stream

output_contract.description: HTML fragment rendered from the input Markdown and returned in the html field.
